description: Remove all visible HTML tags and encoded entities from Modern CV output across live preview, Apercu, PDF export, and DOCX export while preserving formatting.

userStories.title: Audit HTML tag leakage points in Modern CV
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to identify every location where HTML tags or encoded entities appear as visible text in the Modern CV so the fix targets all sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify all fields storing HTML rendered by Modern CV: summary, experience.description, experience.achievements, skillsHtml, project.description
Map each field to its rendering path in modern-template.tsx (preview), PDF pipeline, and docx-modern.ts (DOCX)
Document which functions each field uses: formatText(), renderFormattedText(), dangerouslySetInnerHTML, parseHtmlToDocxRuns()
Identify the skills data source mismatch: preview reads items (plain text) while DOCX reads skillsHtml (HTML)
Document findings as comments in the commit or in progress.txt before any code change
Typecheck passes (pnpm lint)
Build passes (pnpm build)
